stories.title: ATC sentences Imaan, Hadi to 10 years in security breach case
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: An anti-terrorism court on Thursday sentenced human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, to 10 years in prison each in the security breach case.

stories.title: Singapore foreign minister to undertake official visit to Pakistan on Oct 30
stories.brief: During the visit, Dar and Dr Balakrishnan will hold bilateral talks covering the entire spectrum of Pakistan-Singapore relations and exchange views on regional and global developments of mutual interest, it added. Balakrishnan will also call on Pakistan’s leadership, the FO said.

stories.title: Singapore foreign minister to visit Pakistan on Friday for bilateral talks: MoFA
stories.brief: Singapore’s Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan would undertake an official visit to Islamabad on October 30 (Friday) at the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) said on Thursday. The ministry said that Balakrishnan would also call on Pakistan’s leadership during his visit.

stories.title: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss
stories.brief: The Russian President praised Musk and said they are in "close" contact.

stories.title: At least 5 killed, over two dozen injured as bus plunges into drain in Punjab's Hafizabad
stories.brief: LAHORE: At least five people were killed and 27 others injured when a passenger bus plunged into a drain in Punjab’s Hafizabad district on Thursday, according to Rescue 1122. Five rescue vehicles participated in the operation, Rescue 1122 said.

stories.title: Five dead, several injured as bus plunges into drain in Hafizabad: Rescue 1122
stories.brief: At least five people died, and multiple were injured after a passenger bus overturned and plunged into a drainage channel near Fatehke in Pindi Bhattian, Punjab’s Hafizabad district, early on Thursday, Rescue 1122 said.

stories.title: Building boom puts 300,000 people in the path of potential Himalayan disasters
stories.brief: The construction of tourism facilities, housing, and infrastructure has surged in parts of Nepal and India's Uttarakhand.

stories.title: 'Absolutely absurd verdict': Lawyers, journalists react to Imaan, Hadi's sentencing in security breach case
stories.brief: This time, the couple was sentenced to 10 years in a security breach case following a jail trial. Journalist Zarrar Khuhro also pointed out that the couple was sentenced to 10 years for “removing a barrier”. “A decade in jail is what rapists usually get,” he said.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz approves expansion of Karachi, Lahore airports
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday approved the expansion of Karachi and Lahore airports under their respective master plans, directing authorities to complete the projects within the stipulated timelines and ensure compliance with international standards.

stories.title: Arrest warrants for Sohail Afridi, others out in Radio Pakistan attack case
stories.brief: PESHAWAR: An anti-terrorism court on Wednesday issued arrest warrants for Sohail Afridi, the ex-chief minister who was rendered nonfunctional after the imposition of governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and four other PTI leaders in the Radio Pakistan attack case.

stories.title: Govt unleashes storm on Fazl over criticism of defence minister's absence from Tehran talks
stories.brief: The minister's remarks came a day after Fazl criticised Asif during a National Assembly session, questioning the government's role in discussions related to the Makkah defence pact in Tehran while the prime minister and defence minister remained in Pakistan.

stories.title: Terrorist killed in intelligence-based operation in Balochistan's Kech district: state media
stories.brief: Security forces killed a terrorist belonging to Fitna al-Hindustan during an intelligence-based operation (IBO) in the Minaz area of Balochistan's Kech district under Operation Radd-ul-Fitna 3, Radio Pakistan reported on Thursday, citing security sources. Security forces pursued the fleeing terrorists, and one was killed during an exchange of fire, the sources said.

stories.title: ATC issues Sohail Afridi's arrest warrants
stories.brief: Defence counsel Ali Zaman Advocate appeared for the nominated accused, while investigating officer Khushhal, the public prosecutor and Radio Pakistan counsel Shabbir Hussain Ghaigiani were also present.

stories.title: 'Painful' years ahead, think tanks warn, as living standards set to fall
stories.brief: Budget forecasts show growth in living standards grinding almost to a halt.

stories.title: US economy grows faster than expected in report out just ahead of elections
stories.brief: Economists polled by Reuters had forecast GDP advancing at a 3.2% pace.

stories.title: I earn £30,000. I'm angry there was no fuel duty cut in the Budget
stories.brief: People on a range of incomes from £4,062 to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they made of this year's Budget.

stories.title: Europe’s central bank chief Christine Lagarde to step down nine months early
stories.brief: Her term was scheduled to run until the end of October next year.

stories.title: 'I live with a ghost' - inside the haunted homes attracting bargain hunters
stories.brief: Properties where someone has died in tragic circumstances can have big reductions in price.

stories.title: Hello Kitty maker cuts ties with Japanese spy drama after China backlash
stories.brief: Sanrio has apologised after its merchandise line with Japanese TV series Vivant drew criticism.

stories.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
stories.brief: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.
